neighbours.label: calling something precious or irreplaceable, in any language (irreplaceable photos, valuable paintings, 無價之寶, 貴重, драгоценный), as opposed to plain adjectives
fire: A fire can mean the loss of irreplaceable letters.
The museum houses priceless paintings from Spain.
貴重な資料が失われました。
A flood could ruin your valuable records.
Time is our most precious resource.
This is a very valuable collection of coins.
quiet: A fire can mean the loss of old letters.
The museum houses recent paintings from Spain.
古い資料が失われました。
A flood could ruin your wet records.
Time is our next big topic.
This is a very large collection of coins.
